introHeading: The mirror booth on DUMBO's cobblestones and waterfront
introParas: DUMBO is a neighborhood people already travel to for photos, so the mirror booth fits in rather than standing out — one more reason for a wedding party or a corporate crowd to line up in front of something that flatters them. The full-length gold frame means the whole group can pile in at once, DSLR and studio ring light doing the actual work behind the glass, whether the venue is a converted warehouse on Water Street or a private space tucked under the Manhattan Bridge archway.

The real planning happens before we arrive. DUMBO's cobblestone streets are not kind to rolling equipment, so load-in gets mapped street by street rather than assumed, and we build in extra time for waterfront and archway venues where a truck can't always pull up to the door. None of that shows up on your side — it just means the mirror is tested and ready well before your first guest walks in, wherever on Water Street or Jay Street that door happens to be.

Setup itself takes about 20 minutes once we're inside, and we arrive a full hour ahead of your start time. The booth wants a 10ft x 10ft footprint with room for a backdrop and props table, compressing to 8ft x 8ft with 7.5ft of ceiling clearance for a tighter archway space, and it needs a standard 110V outlet within 15 feet. There is no travel fee anywhere in DUMBO — it's a local run for us, quoted from your venue ZIP code before you book.

faqHeading: Mirror Photo Booth in DUMBO — FAQ

faqs.q: Does the mirror booth work at a DUMBO waterfront or archway venue?
faqs.a: Yes — those are some of the most common venues we set up in across DUMBO. Waterfront and archway spaces often have limited vehicle access, so we schedule extra load-in time to get the mirror positioned and tested well before your first guest arrives.

faqs.q: How do you get the mirror booth in over DUMBO's cobblestone streets?
faqs.a: Carefully, and planned in advance rather than figured out on the day. Cobblestones are hard on rolling equipment, so we walk the route from parking to your venue's door ahead of time and carry what needs carrying rather than rolling it the whole way.

faqs.q: Do you charge extra to bring the mirror booth to DUMBO?
faqs.a: No travel fee — DUMBO is a local run for us. We quote everything from your venue ZIP code before you book, so there's nothing to discover on the invoice afterward.

faqs.q: Can guests sign or write on their photo at the mirror booth?
faqs.a: Yes. The touchscreen supports on-screen signatures and drawings, so guests can leave a message right on their print — a favorite at DUMBO weddings where the couple keeps every strip in a guest book afterward.

faqs.q: Can the mirror booth work in a smaller, historic DUMBO space rather than a big warehouse floor?
faqs.a: Yes. We can compress the footprint to 8ft x 8ft with 7.5ft of ceiling clearance, which fits comfortably into the smaller, older buildings common around Vinegar Hill and Water Street — just tell us your venue's dimensions ahead of time so we can confirm the fit.

faqs.q: How much space does the mirror booth need?
faqs.a: The optimal footprint is 10ft x 10ft, which leaves room for the backdrop, props table and a red carpet if you want one. We can compress to a minimum of 8ft x 8ft with 7.5ft of ceiling clearance, and we need one standard 110V outlet within 15 feet.

faqs.q: Is an attendant included with a DUMBO mirror booth rental?
faqs.a: Yes. A trained attendant runs the booth for the full length of your DUMBO rental — setup, keeping the prop table organized, helping guests use the touchscreen, and packing down at the end of the night.

faqs.q: How long does setup take, and can you arrive early for a DUMBO event?
faqs.a: Setup takes about 20 minutes once we're inside, and we arrive a full hour before your scheduled start time so everything is tested and quiet before guests arrive. If your venue needs us on site earlier than that, idle time runs $150 per hour.

faqs.q: Do you carry insurance and can you provide a COI for a DUMBO venue?
faqs.a: Yes. We carry a $3 million insurance policy. If your venue needs a certificate of insurance naming them as additionally insured, reply to your booking confirmation with their contact email and we will send it over.

faqs.q: Which DUMBO areas do you cover?
faqs.a: We're out across Vinegar Hill, Brooklyn Heights, Fulton Ferry, Water Street, Jay Street and the surrounding areas most weekends of the season. If your venue isn't on that list, ask anyway — we'll tell you honestly whether we can get there.
